The BlueEarth CST toolbox implements a five-workflow climate stress test. This reference describes the workflow boundaries and the data they consume and produce. For the assessment rationale and interpretation of a climate response surface, start with [Scientific approach](../scientific-approach/overview.qmd).

## Find an interface

1. [Assessment workflow](assessment-workflow.qmd) summarizes WF0–WF4, their dependencies, and their main products.
2. [Datasets](datasets.qmd) identifies the role of each source and the consequences of substituting it.
3. [Configuration](../guide/configuration.qmd) explains the project file and workflow settings files.
4. [Running the workflows](../guide/running.qmd) gives the supported commands and options.
5. [Reading the outputs](../guide/outputs.qmd) explains the retained product layout and the identifiers used to join results.

The configuration, running, and output pages remain in the User guide so their procedures are available where readers carry out an assessment.
